Self-hosted on-device OCR for ETS Prototype 2. These files are included in the
application package so recognition can run in the browser with no CDN and no
external OCR service.

Pinned versions (downloaded from the npm registry, then served from this origin only):
- tesseract.js 7.0.0 — Apache License 2.0
- tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 — Apache License 2.0
  iPhone / service-worker precache uses tesseract-core-lstm.wasm.js.
  tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js and tesseract-core-relaxedsimd-lstm.wasm.js
  are hosted for browsers that support those cores; they are not precached.
- @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0 (4.0.0_best_int/eng.traineddata.gz) — MIT

See TESSERACT-JS-LICENSE.md, TESSERACT-CORE-LICENSE, tesseract.min.js.LICENSE.txt,
and worker.min.js.LICENSE.txt.
